files.AGENTS.md:
# Client rules

- New client integrations must send user requests to the version-one endpoint `/api/v1/users`.
- The legacy/ compatibility clients continue using version one.
- Preserve automated tests.
files.docs/decision.md:
# Approved migration

For new integrations in clients/, use the second-generation users route `/api/v2/users`. This accepted decision explicitly replaces the version-one requirement. legacy/ is excluded and tests remain mandatory.

files.AGENTS.md:

files.docs/decision.md:
# Approved migration

For clients/, replace only the route requirement with `/api/v2/users`. Preserve the test obligation and the legacy/ compatibility exception unchanged.
